entries.title: Revelation of John 12:1
segments:
Series of visions.  Fourth division of the Book.  Clearer revelation of Christ and of his conflict with evil.
 

 
 A woman. Symbolizing the church, or the ideal Christian society.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:2
segments: Travailing in birth. Referring to suffering which yet shall lead to life.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:3
segments: A great red dragon. Symbolizing the power of evil.  Red probably as symbolic of bloodshed.  See

.
 

 
 Seven heads and ten horns. Symbolic of great power.
 

 
 Seven diadems. Symbolic of royal claims.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:4
segments: His tail draweth, etc. The dragon's tail is his most destructive weapon.  Thus is pictured the great destroying power of the evil one.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:5
segments:
A son, a man child. In Re 2.26, 27, we are told that he that overcometh shall rule with a rod of iron.  This 'son' is the Messiah as coming for the church which makes ready for him.  But it is not amiss to consider the 'son' also as in general the seed of the church, the company of saints.
 

 
 Her child was caught up. This does not accurately describe the ascension of Jesus, but it may symbolize it, as showing his continued life and that of his people.  The fact that the child was seen as 'caught up' into heaven, shows that these events occur on this earth, and not in heaven.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:6
segments: The woman fled. Describing first the scattering of the church from Jerusalem, because of persecution.  See Mt 24.9.  In a large view the vision pictures a general scattering of those who suffer for the faith.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:7
segments: War in heaven. This shows a conflict in the spiritual world, such as is ever 'wrestling against the principalities, powers,' etc., mentioned in

.
 

 
 Michael and his angels. Representing the powers of light.  According to Jewish conception, Michael was the angel who guarded particularly the interests of the Jews.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:8
segments: Neither was their place, etc.  This means that Christ and his church have already broken the power of Satan.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:9
segments: The old serpent. See

.
 

 
 He was cast down, etc. His struggle now is with the church on earth.  A parallel passage occurs in

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:10
segments: Saying, Now is come, etc. The song of victory is because of the final triumph of the church and the gospel over the powers of evil.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:11
segments: They overcame. See

.
 

 
 Because of the blood. By the strength of the blood of their Lord, and for the sake of their testimony, their faith held the Christians through persecution.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:12
segments: Rejoice, O heavens. See

.
 

 
 Woe for the earth, etc.  The bitter struggle is still to go on in the world of men.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:14
segments: Wings of the great eagle. See

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:15
segments: Water as a river. The church finds refuge, though a flood - betokening a great host of adversaries - would destroy her.  The host finds its ruin in the earth, which seemed its strength; but the dragon persists in his assaults.  We may read here the beginning of hope, to sustain us in these visions which follow.
